name: http
summary: The Dart team's composable, multi-platform, Future-based HTTP client API.
advantages: Runs across Dart and Flutter platforms
tradeoffs: Does not provide Dio-style interceptors, cancellation, or transformer features out of the box
Complex API clients may require additional architecture and boilerplate
recommendedFor: Packages that want a small broadly supported HTTP abstraction
Projects that do not require interceptor-heavy networking features
